findings.detail: The DEMAND_FEATURE validity dependency uses demand_basis[2] (S37.ref_s34_id, the N proposal for the full profile) as attributes.proposal_id. The physical S35 dependency is D and D.ref_s34_id names F. This is inaccurate explanatory certificate metadata. It does not replace authoritative dependency checks: _progress_sources and the merged full reconstruction require D-to-F, N-to-F/D, both exact per-action resolutions and shared S37, and issuance rows retain exact member-specific resolution and prescription content.
